entries.title: Genesis 46:1
segments: ¶So Israel took his journey with all that he had, and came to Beersheba, and offered sacrifices to the God of his father Isaac.

entries.title: Genesis 46:2
segments: Then God spoke to Israel in the visions of the night, and said, "Jacob, Jacob!" And he said, "Here I am."

entries.title: Genesis 46:3
segments: So He said, "I [am] God, the God of your father; do not fear to go down to Egypt, for I will make of you a great nation there.

entries.title: Genesis 46:4
segments: "I will go down with you to Egypt, and I will also surely bring you up [again]; and Joseph will put his hand on your eyes."

entries.title: Genesis 46:5
segments: ¶Then Jacob arose from Beersheba; and the sons of Israel carried their father Jacob, their little ones, and their wives, in the carts which Pharaoh had sent to carry him.

entries.title: Genesis 46:6
segments: So they took their livestock and their goods, which they had acquired in the land of Canaan, and went to Egypt, Jacob and all his descendants with him.

entries.title: Genesis 46:7
segments: His sons and his sons' sons, his daughters and his sons' daughters, and all his descendants he brought with him to Egypt.

entries.title: Genesis 46:8
segments: Now these [were] the names of the children of Israel, Jacob and his sons, who went to Egypt: Reuben [was] Jacob's firstborn.

entries.title: Genesis 46:9
segments: The sons of Reuben [were] Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.

entries.title: Genesis 46:10
segments: The sons of Simeon [were] Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jachin, Zohar, and Shaul, the son of a Canaanite woman.

entries.title: Genesis 46:11
segments: The sons of Levi [were] Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

entries.title: Genesis 46:12
segments: The sons of Judah [were] Er, Onan, Shelah, Perez, and Zerah (but Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan). The sons of Perez were Hezron and Hamul.

entries.title: Genesis 46:13
segments: The sons of Issachar [were] Tola, Puvah, Job, and Shimron.

entries.title: Genesis 46:14
segments: The sons of Zebulun [were] Sered, Elon, and Jahleel.

entries.title: Genesis 46:15
segments: These [were] the sons of Leah, whom she bore to Jacob in Padan Aram, with his daughter Dinah. All the persons, his sons and his daughters, [were] thirty-three.

entries.title: Genesis 46:16
segments: The sons of Gad [were] Ziphion, Haggi, Shuni, Ezbon, Eri, Arodi, and Areli.

entries.title: Genesis 46:17
segments: The sons of Asher [were] Jimnah, Ishuah, Isui, Beriah, and Serah, their sister. And the sons of Beriah [were] Heber and Malchiel.

entries.title: Genesis 46:18
segments: These [were] the sons of Zilpah, whom Laban gave to Leah his daughter; and these she bore to Jacob: sixteen persons.

entries.title: Genesis 46:19
segments: The sons of Rachel, Jacob's wife, [were] Joseph and Benjamin.

entries.title: Genesis 46:20
segments: And to Joseph in the land of Egypt were born Manasseh and Ephraim, whom Asenath, the daughter of Poti-Pherah priest of On, bore to him.

entries.title: Genesis 46:21
segments: The sons of Benjamin [were] Belah, Becher, Ashbel, Gera, Naaman, Ehi, Rosh, Muppim, Huppim, and Ard.

entries.title: Genesis 46:22
segments: These [were] the sons of Rachel, who were born to Jacob: fourteen persons in all.

entries.title: Genesis 46:23
segments: The son of Dan [was] Hushim.

entries.title: Genesis 46:24
segments: The sons of Naphtali [were] Jahzeel, Guni, Jezer, and Shillem.

entries.title: Genesis 46:25
segments: These [were] the sons of Bilhah, whom Laban gave to Rachel his daughter, and she bore these to Jacob: seven persons in all.

entries.title: Genesis 46:26
segments: All the persons who went with Jacob to Egypt, who came from his body, besides Jacob's sons' wives, [were] sixty-six persons in all.

entries.title: Genesis 46:27
segments: And the sons of Joseph who were born to him in Egypt [were] two persons. All the persons of the house of Jacob who went to Egypt were seventy.

entries.title: Genesis 46:28
segments: ¶Then he sent Judah before him to Joseph, to point out before him [the way] to Goshen. And they came to the land of Goshen.

entries.title: Genesis 46:29
segments: So Joseph made ready his chariot and went up to Goshen to meet his father Israel; and he presented himself to him, and fell on his neck and wept on his neck a good while.

entries.title: Genesis 46:30
segments: And Israel said to Joseph, "Now let me die, since I have seen your face, because you [are] still alive."

entries.title: Genesis 46:31
segments: Then Joseph said to his brothers and to his father's household, "I will go up and tell Pharaoh, and say to him, 'My brothers and those of my father's house, who [were] in the land of Canaan, have come to me.

entries.title: Genesis 46:32
segments: 'And the men [are] shepherds, for their occupation has been to feed livestock; and they have brought their flocks, their herds, and all that they have.'

entries.title: Genesis 46:33
segments: "So it shall be, when Pharaoh calls you and says, 'What is your occupation?'

entries.title: Genesis 46:34
segments: "that you shall say, 'Your servants' occupation has been with livestock from our youth even till now, both we [and] also our fathers,' that you may dwell in the land of Goshen; for every shepherd [is] an abomination to the Egyptians."
